commoner.name: Commoner
commoner.tactic: Runs or surrenders unless cornered or defending family.

giant-fire-beetle.name: Giant Fire Beetle
giant-fire-beetle.tactic: Bites whatever comes closest and does not retreat.
traits: Illumination: bright light 10 ft., dim light 10 ft. more
Blindsight 30 ft.

lemure.name: Lemure
lemure.tactic: Shambles at the nearest enemy in a mindless mob.
traits: Resistant to cold
Immune to fire and poison; immune to charmed, frightened, poisoned
Darkvision 120 ft., sees through magical darkness
Hellish Rejuvenation: re-forms in 1d10 days in its home plane unless killed by a good creature under bless or doused in holy water

kobold.name: Kobold
kobold.tactic: Swarms one target for pack tactics and flees when outnumbered.
traits: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target
Sunlight Sensitivity: disadvantage on attacks and sight Perception in sunlight
Sling range 30/120 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.tactic: Opens with crossbows from cover, then closes in; runs once the fight turns.
traits: Light crossbow range 80/320 ft.

cultist.name: Cultist
cultist.tactic: Fights with zeal to protect the leader and rarely flees.
traits: Dark Devotion: advantage on saves against charmed and frightened

guard.name: Guard
guard.tactic: Holds a line, calls for help, and tries to arrest before killing.
traits: Spear deals 1d8+1 two-handed; thrown range 20/60 ft.

giant-rat.name: Giant Rat
giant-rat.tactic: Attacks in a swarm and scatters when half the pack is dead.
traits: Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target
Keen Smell: advantage on smell Perception
Darkvision 60 ft.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.tactic: Shoots from hiding, then uses Nimble Escape to hide again; flees when losing.
traits: Nimble Escape: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action
Stealth +6
Shortbow range 80/320 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.tactic: Follows its last order without fear and never retreats.
traits: Vulnerable to bludgeoning
Immune to poison; immune to exhaustion and poisoned
Shortbow range 80/320 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.tactic: Walks straight at the nearest living creature and keeps slamming.
traits: Undead Fortitude: when reduced to 0 HP, Con save DC 5 + damage taken to drop to 1 HP instead, unless radiant or a critical hit
Immune to poison and poisoned
Darkvision 60 ft.

wolf.name: Wolf
wolf.tactic: Circles with the pack, drags one target prone, and breaks off when badly hurt.
traits: Bite: target makes a DC 11 Str save or falls prone
Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target
Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on those Perception checks

orc.name: Orc
orc.tactic: Throws a javelin, then charges with Aggressive and fights to the death.
traits: Aggressive: bonus action to move up to its speed toward a hostile creature
Javelin range 30/120 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.tactic: Fights in disciplined ranks and pairs up on targets for Martial Advantage.
traits: Martial Advantage: once per turn +2d6 damage if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target
Longsword deals 1d10+1 two-handed
Longbow range 150/600 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

gnoll.name: Gnoll
gnoll.tactic: Goes for the weakest target to trigger Rampage and chain kills.
traits: Rampage: after dropping a creature to 0 HP in melee, bonus action to move half speed and bite
Spear deals 1d8+2 two-handed; thrown range 20/60 ft.
Longbow range 150/600 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

giant-spider.name: Giant Spider
giant-spider.tactic: Webs a target from above, then bites the restrained prey.
traits: Bite venom: on a bite hit, DC 11 Con save for 2d8 poison, half on success; at 0 HP from it the target is stable but poisoned and paralyzed for 1 hour
Web (recharge 5-6): ranged attack 30/60 ft., target restrained; DC 12 Str check to escape; web has AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerable to fire
Spider Climb, Web Sense, Web Walker; climb 30 ft.
Stealth +7
Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft.

bugbear.name: Bugbear
bugbear.tactic: Ambushes from hiding for Surprise Attack and retreats if the ambush fails.
traits: Brute: extra weapon die already included in melee damage
Surprise Attack: +2d6 damage on a hit against a surprised creature in the first round
Javelin thrown deals 1d6+2, range 30/120 ft.
Stealth +6
Darkvision 60 ft.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.tactic: Claws to paralyze, then bites the helpless victim.
traits: Claws: non-elf, non-undead target makes a DC 10 Con save or is paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn
Immune to poison; immune to charmed, exhaustion, poisoned
Darkvision 60 ft.

dire-wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire-wolf.tactic: Knocks a target prone so the pack can tear into it.
traits: Bite: target makes a DC 13 Str save or falls prone
Pack Tactics: advantage on attacks if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target
Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on those Perception checks

brown-bear.name: Brown Bear
brown-bear.tactic: Mauls whatever threatens it or its cubs and leaves once the threat backs off.
traits: Multiattack: one bite and one claws
Keen Smell: advantage on smell Perception
Climb 30 ft.

specter.name: Specter
specter.tactic: Strikes out of walls and floors, then withdraws back into them.
traits: Speed is fly 50 ft. (hover); walking speed 0
Life Drain: DC 10 Con save or HP maximum drops by the damage taken until a long rest
Resistant to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
Immune to necrotic and poison; immune to charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
Incorporeal Movement: moves through creatures and objects; 1d10 force if it ends its turn inside an object
Sunlight Sensitivity: disadvantage on attacks and sight Perception in sunlight
Darkvision 60 ft.

animated-armor.name: Animated Armor
animated-armor.tactic: Stands still until intruders pass, then attacks the nearest until destroyed.
traits: Multiattack: two slams
Immune to poison and psychic; immune to blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
Antimagic Susceptibility: incapacitated in an antimagic field; dispel magic forces a Con save against the caster's DC or it falls unconscious for 1 minute
False Appearance: looks like a normal suit of armor while motionless
Blindsight 60 ft.

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.tactic: Sings victims toward a hazard, then attacks the charmed from the air.
traits: Multiattack: one claws and one club
Fly 40 ft.
Luring Song: humanoids and giants within 300 ft. make a DC 11 Wis save or are charmed and must move toward the harpy; repeat save at end of each turn

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.tactic: Smashes the biggest or nearest target and is easily tricked or bribed.
traits: Javelin range 30/120 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

gelatinous-cube.name: Gelatinous Cube
gelatinous-cube.tactic: Slides down corridors engulfing everything in its path.
traits: Engulf: moves into creatures' spaces; DC 12 Dex save or engulfed, restrained, and takes 6d6 acid at the start of each cube turn; DC 12 Str check to escape
Transparent: DC 15 Perception to spot it when motionless
Immune to blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
Blindsight 60 ft.

ochre-jelly.name: Ochre Jelly
ochre-jelly.tactic: Drops from walls or ceilings onto prey and follows it relentlessly.
traits: Pseudopod hit adds 1d6 acid
Resistant to acid; immune to lightning and slashing
Split: when a Medium or larger jelly with 10+ HP takes lightning or slashing, it splits into two jellies with half its HP each, one size smaller
Amorphous: squeezes through 1-inch gaps
Spider Climb; climb 10 ft.
Immune to blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
Blindsight 60 ft.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.tactic: Waits as an object for a touch, sticks the victim, then bites.
traits: Bite hit adds 1d8 acid
Adhesive: a creature hit by the pseudopod is grappled, escape DC 13 with disadvantage
Grappler: advantage on attacks against a creature it grapples
Immune to acid; immune to prone
Shapechanger and False Appearance: looks like an ordinary object while motionless
Darkvision 60 ft.

gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.tactic: Poses as a statue, then dives on the rear of the party.
traits: Multiattack: one bite and one claws
Fly 60 ft.
Resistant to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is not adamantine
Immune to poison; immune to exhaustion, petrified, poisoned
False Appearance: looks like a statue while motionless
Darkvision 60 ft.

ghast.name: Ghast
ghast.tactic: Leads ghouls, paralyzes the strongest fighter, and lets the pack feed.
traits: Claws: non-undead target makes a DC 10 Con save or is paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn
Stench: a creature starting its turn within 5 ft. makes a DC 10 Con save or is poisoned until its next turn; success gives 24-hour immunity
Turning Defiance: it and ghouls within 30 ft. have advantage on saves against turning
Resistant to necrotic; immune to poison; immune to charmed, exhaustion, poisoned
Darkvision 60 ft.

bandit-captain.name: Bandit Captain
bandit-captain.tactic: Duels the most dangerous foe while ordering bandits to flank; bargains when losing.
traits: Multiattack: two scimitar attacks and one dagger, or two thrown daggers
Parry: reaction, +2 AC against one melee attack it can see
Dagger range 20/60 ft.
Saves: Str +4, Dex +5, Wis +2

priest.name: Priest
priest.tactic: Opens with spirit guardians, heals allies, and keeps fighters between itself and the enemy.
traits: Spellcasting: 5th-level caster, save DC 13, +5 to hit, slots 4/3/2; cure wounds, guiding bolt, sanctuary, lesser restoration, spiritual weapon, dispel magic, spirit guardians
Divine Eminence: bonus action, spend a slot for +3d6 radiant on mace hits until end of turn, +1d6 per slot level above 1st

owlbear.name: Owlbear
owlbear.tactic: Charges the first creature it notices and fights until dead.
traits: Multiattack: one beak and one claws
Keen Sight and Smell: advantage on those Perception checks
Darkvision 60 ft.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.tactic: Shifts to hybrid form, trusts its immunity, and targets unarmored victims.
traits: Multiattack: two attacks, one bite and one claws or spear (humanoid or hybrid form)
AC 12 in wolf or hybrid form, 11 in humanoid form; speed 40 ft. in wolf form
Bite: humanoid target makes a DC 12 Con save or is cursed with werewolf lycanthropy
Immune to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is not silvered
Shapechanger: action to change between humanoid, wolf, and hybrid forms
Spear deals 1d8+2 two-handed (humanoid form only); claws hybrid form only
Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on those Perception checks

wight.name: Wight
wight.tactic: Commands lesser undead, drains wounded foes, and avoids daylight.
traits: Multiattack: two longsword or two longbow attacks; Life Drain can replace one longsword attack
Life Drain: DC 13 Con save or HP maximum drops by the damage taken until a long rest; a humanoid slain rises as a zombie in 24 hours
Resistant to necrotic and to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is not silvered
Immune to poison; immune to exhaustion and poisoned
Sunlight Sensitivity: disadvantage on attacks and sight Perception in sunlight
Longsword deals 1d10+2 two-handed
Longbow range 150/600 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.tactic: Glares to freeze one intruder and pounds it with the rotting fist.
traits: Multiattack: Dreadful Glare and one rotting fist
Rotting Fist hit adds 3d6 necrotic; DC 12 Con save or cursed with mummy rot: no HP recovery and HP maximum drops 3d6 every 24 hours
Dreadful Glare: one creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 11 Wis save or is frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn; paralyzed too if it fails by 5 or more
Vulnerable to fire
Resistant to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
Immune to necrotic and poison; immune to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
Saves: Wis +2
Darkvision 60 ft.

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.tactic: Lets its gaze do the work and bites whatever is slowed.
traits: Bite hit adds 2d6 poison

Petrifying Gaze: a creature starting its turn within 30 ft. that can see its eyes makes a DC 12 Con save; fail is restrained, a second fail at the end of its next turn is petrified; fail by 5 or more is petrified at once
Darkvision 60 ft.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.tactic: Fights with discipline, focuses one foe at a time, and withdraws in good order.
traits: Multiattack: two longsword attacks, plus one shortsword attack if it has a shortsword drawn
Longsword deals 1d10+3 two-handed
Heavy crossbow range 100/400 ft.

knight.name: Knight
knight.tactic: Uses Leadership first, challenges the strongest foe, and honors a surrender.
traits: Multiattack: two melee attacks
Brave: advantage on saves against frightened
Leadership (recharges on a short or long rest): for 1 minute, allies within 30 ft. that can hear it add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves
Parry: reaction, +2 AC against one melee attack it can see
Saves: Con +4, Wis +2
Heavy crossbow range 100/400 ft.

ettin.name: Ettin
ettin.tactic: Splits its two attacks between the two nearest enemies while its heads argue.
traits: Multiattack: one battleaxe and one morningstar
Two Heads: advantage on Perception and on saves against blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, unconscious
Wakeful: one head stays awake while the other sleeps
Darkvision 60 ft.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.tactic: Frightens the group, possesses the strongest body, and turns it on its friends.
traits: Speed is fly 40 ft. (hover); walking speed 0
Horrifying Visage: non-undead within 60 ft. make a DC 13 Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute; fail by 5 or more also ages 1d4 x 10 years
Possession (recharge 6): one humanoid within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Cha save or is possessed; ends at 0 HP or when turned
Etherealness: shifts between the Ethereal and Material planes
Resistant to acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
Immune to cold, necrotic, poison; immune to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
Incorporeal Movement: moves through creatures and objects; 1d10 force if it ends its turn inside an object
Darkvision 60 ft.

red-dragon-wyrmling.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
red-dragon-wyrmling.tactic: Breathes fire on the largest cluster, then bites from the air; flees to guard its hoard.
traits: Bite hit adds 1d6 fire
Fire Breath (recharge 5-6): 15-ft. cone, DC 13 Dex save, half damage on success
Immune to fire
Climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft.
Saves: Dex +2, Con +5, Wis +2, Cha +4
Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft.

troll.name: Troll
troll.tactic: Wades in without fear of wounds and only backs away from fire or acid.
traits: Multiattack: one bite and two claws
Regeneration: regains 10 HP at the start of its turn; acid or fire damage stops it for one turn; dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and cannot regenerate
Keen Smell: advantage on smell Perception
Darkvision 60 ft.

air-elemental.name: Air Elemental
air-elemental.tactic: Sweeps through the group with Whirlwind, then slams scattered targets.
traits: Speed is fly 90 ft. (hover); walking speed 0
Multiattack: two slams
Whirlwind (recharge 4-6): creatures in its space make a DC 13 Str save or take the damage, are flung up to 20 ft., and fall prone; half damage and not flung on success
Resistant to lightning, thunder, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
Immune to poison; immune to exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious
Air Form: enters hostile spaces and passes through 1-inch gaps
Darkvision 60 ft.

hill-giant.name: Hill Giant
hill-giant.tactic: Hurls rocks while foes approach, then clubs the closest; backs down from a show of strength.
traits: Multiattack: two greatclub attacks
Rock range 60/240 ft.
